entities.name: Klemen Prepelič
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Klemen Prepelič is a Slovenian professional basketball player and the team captain for Dubai Basketball of the ABA League and the EuroLeague. He also represents the Slovenian national basketball team internationally. Standing at 1.91 m, he plays at the shooting guard position.
